video_title: Devin Booker Training Camp Media Availability | Phoenix Suns | 9-30-26

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.text: I think the game is positioning us well and I even talked about with the addition of Miles another person that can play make. I think everybody on the court needs to be able to have those abilities. It frees up everybody, makes for a free flow offense and you learn with experience. You learn by being thrown in the fire, being trusted with those responsibilities and we have been seeing it in camp already with them, so it has been good.
quotes.pull_quote: It frees up everybody, makes for a free flow offense
quotes.news_angle: Devin Booker says the addition of Miles helps the team's playmaking and offense.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker says the addition of Miles helps the team's playmaking and offense, noting that it frees up everyone and makes for a free flow offense.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.text: Way ahead of his age. You cannot say enough about a player like that. He knows his role, he knows his responsibility and some guys are 10 years in the league and still do not know that. For him to come in with that mindset, for him to come in willing to learn and then his work ethic is matching with it. You see him putting the extra reps in, so he has all the intangibles of being a star and he is going to get that opportunity this year.
quotes.pull_quote: He has all the intangibles of being a star
quotes.news_angle: Devin Booker praises a young teammate for his maturity and work ethic.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker is impressed by his young teammate, saying he is way ahead of his age and has all the intangibles of being a star.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.text: I went to his studio probably three or four years ago during fashion week in New York. It is over there in Brooklyn and just got to go through his collections. His collection of camouflage, his Lego collection, got to see it all firsthand and then ended up inviting him to a game a couple of years ago and he ended up doing a graffiti piece for me for my warehouse and then we just brought that idea to Nike, you know, make a shoe off of the piece that he made for me and it is one of my favorites to date.
quotes.pull_quote: It is one of my favorites to date
quotes.news_angle: Devin Booker discusses the inspiration behind his new Nike shoe design.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker shares the story behind his new Nike shoe, which was inspired by a graffiti piece created for his warehouse.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.text: It is a balance that changes game to game. I said at media day I want to shoot more, but if teams are throwing three people at you, then you have to get off it. But I just said that from a mindset standpoint. I want to assert myself by scoring the ball more and that is how it is going to open up easier opportunities for my teammates.
quotes.pull_quote: I want to assert myself by scoring the ball more
quotes.news_angle: Devin Booker says he wants to be more aggressive scoring the ball this season.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker says he wants to be more aggressive scoring the ball this season, noting that it will open up easier opportunities for his teammates.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.text: Taking pride on that end, especially coming into the league, I had a reputation of not being able to guard at all and I think at this point it has changed in a way. But it is something that you have to stay on every night in and every night out. So something I take pride in. Communicating, it takes five people to have a good defensive possession because you might be helping on a possession and it might not be our covers at that time. So the ability to voice communication throughout five guys is important.
quotes.pull_quote: It takes five people to have a good defensive possession
quotes.news_angle: Devin Booker emphasizes the importance of communication and team defense.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker says he takes pride in his defense, noting that it takes five people to have a good defensive possession.
